description: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper Level 60 Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke. Requirements: - Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper
name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
